subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.FT.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 103 (CS-31). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the subject; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics), EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From SCI-DY: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From CULT-SOLD: IST-PT (isolated particulars). From IST-PT: SOC-PR (social programs), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", written after the label. From EXB-H-OR: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From RT-INT-TR: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: APL-DT (application dictates).
